translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

book.name: LUGU
book.title: Lugu Luguhanda Bi Mana Debene gili binigo ogo

content: Agali homogo Tiobilasa-o mbirale tara tara dewa ina hemagoria biyagonaga te agali dewalime gilibule manda bialu hene.
O biyadagoni tigua de handayarubi bi mana lawai hayarubi piganengi tenialu inahondo langiyadagua bebani gilibu wini.
Anigo i̱na o biyadagoni pigane tenialu biyadagua bayuwa manda buwa í̠ de handalu daga labelonaga gilibu wia hole manda biru.
I̱na ogoni birudagoni ala agali maru hearume bi ogoni í̠hondo lawai hayago heneneore biyagoni í̠na bayuwa manda bibelo i̱na te ogoninaga gilibu wia haro.
Dahuliyalime, Ilisabedehanda Yone taba honolebira, lenego ogo

Yudia dindini wali agali hearu Herodo handame haga kini heangi loma binigo mo miaga agali mbira mini Segaraia hene. Ibu Abaya loma binigo mo miaga henego aria hene. Ibu one mini Ilisabede ibu Arononaga aguanene berene.
Ani buwa libugua Ngode Datagaliwabenaga deni howa bayale dege bialu Anduane Homogonaga bi mana lo wiago bulene wiadaguaore biai halu hene.
Ilisabede ibu waneigini taba hanabe nahe wali tabua berene. Libu waneigini nahe waheore labolabo hene.
Horo mbirungi Segaraia ibu loma binigo mo miaga agali howa loma binigo mo miaga marume biabe bia aribia hagadagua buwa ibugua bulene winingi Anduane Homogonaga andaha howa biabe bialu hene.

Delolenenaga dagia wiagoriani mbirale mini inisenesi Ngode Datagaliwabehondo nga bilo delolene winigo aiwa delolebadabe hondole loma binigo mo miaga hearume dabo handalu hearia Segaraiahanda bulene wini. Ani biya handala ibu Anduane Homogonaga andaha anda pene.
Anda puwa ibugua mbirale mini inisenesi hagua ngabiore bilo lowa delalu hea tambu wali agali dewa tagirani bu hearume Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lalu hene.
Segaraia ibu ani bialu hearia mbirale mini inisenesi hagua ngabiore bilo delolenenaga dagia wiagoriani gi tigahayagi Anduane Homogonaga dahuliyali mbira ibalu ha pani ho hene.
Ha pani ho hearia de hondowa Segaraia ibu minime mogo lowa gi hene.

Gi hayago hondowa dahuliyali biagome ibuhondo lalu, Segaraia-o gi nahabe. Í̠na Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi larigonaga Ngode Datagaliwabe ibu hale hayago í̠ one Ilisabede ibugua igiri mbira taba honolebira. Taba hanaragola í̠na ibu mini Yone wibe, lalu lamini.
Ani lamialu, Igiri ogoni taba hanaragola í̠bi wali agali maru dewa bu karu tibi turu hai ho holeberami.

Taba hanaragola howa ibu Anduane Homogonaga deni howa agali timbuniore holebira. Ani bu howa ibugua waini ibabi lulu yagane iba marubi nolene nawi holebira. Ibu ai̱yahanda ibu taba hanarangiore howa Ngode Datagaliwabe Dinini ibuha ho to̱laihe holebira.
Ho to̱laihe howa ibugua Isaraele wali agali dewa Anduane Homogo tinaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kagoria haru dai biai holebira.

Ngode Datagaliwabe bi mana latagi haga Elaya timbuni hongohe henedagua ibubi ogonibi dege howa Anduane Homogo maha ibilo ibu ala bamba halu pialu holebira. Bamba halu pialu howa ibugua aba ai̱yabi waneiginibi mo mbiraore halu mandagi helalu wali agali Ngode Datagaliwabe bi mana wahalu piaga karu mini mo beregedai halu mini tigabiwi karume manda biagadagua ti manda bilo ibugua mo manda bia holebira. Anduane Homogo ibilo tagi ibugua Anduane Homogonaga wali agali mo tiga bialu manda manda bu helolebira, lalu dahuliyali biagome lamini.
Ani layagola Segaraiahanda dahuliyali biagohondo ladai bialu lalu, I̱bi i̱ onebi iya wali agali tabua labolabo kabagodago í̠na bi larigoni henene lari lalu i̱na agua manda buabe, lene.

Ani layagola dahuliyali biagome ladai bialu lalu, I̱ mini Gaberelo Ngode Datagaliwabe karia haabo haruli. I̱na bi bayale áyu í̠ langirugoni langule Ngode Datagaliwabehanda, Bi ogoni lama pu, layadagoria howa íbu kogoni.

Anigo i̱na bi larogo lola holene tu haragola lola holebiraore. Í̠na bi ogoni mo henene nahe mini kira wu harigo ogoni bulebira langirugo lola holene horo helo nde í̠ bi nalabehe holebere, lalu lamini.

Segaraia ani bialu hea tambu ibu tagira ibilo wali agali tagirani hayaru ti hondo haabo hene. Segaraia ibu Anduane Homogonaga anda tamuha hondo haabo hayagola tigua ibu agi bialu haabo kabe toba howa minime tai bialu hene.

Segaraia ibu tagira ibuwa bi labe naheyagola wali agali biarume ibu tara mbira de gandeba ale Anduane Homogonaga andaha handayadago manda bini. Ibugua tihondo bi nalabehe howa bi loa hayago ibuni gime walia halu hene.
Emene halu ibunaga biabe bulene winigo biai halu Segaraia ibu andaga dai bini.
Mani howa Ilisabede ibu tombeha gali birayagola ibu ege duria andaga biraabo hene.
Biraabo howa lalu, Anduane Homogohanda i̱hondo bayale ogoni biamogo biyada. Ibugua i̱ hondowa dara hayagome ai wali agali marume i̱hondo, Wali tabua bedego, nalolebira, lene.
Dahuliyalime Merihondo, Yasu taba honolebere, lenego ogo
Ilisabede ibu tombeha gali bere berenego ege waraganengi Ngode Datagaliwabehanda dahuliyali mbira mini Gaberelohondo lalu, Í̠ Galilinaga tano mini Nasarete pobe, lene.
Wandari mbira mini Meri Yosebe ibu dabu bule lo berelenego berearia dahuliyali biagome ibuhondo bi lamule pene. Yosebe ibu Isaraele wali agalinaga Kini Debidinaga aguanene hene.
Ani bu berearia dahuliyali biagome puwa lalu, Meri-o mo palia holene í̠ha wiaabo helo laro. Anduane Homogo ibu í̠ heba mandagi howa turu timbuni habelo mo turu haya, lene.
Dahuliyalime bi layago hale howa Meri ibu bi ogoni aginaga larabe toba howa mini burugu lowa tai timbuni bialu berene.
Ani bialu berearia dahuliyali biagome ibuhondo lalu, Ngode Datagaliwabehanda í̠ mitangi bialu í̠hondo turu ho kago gi nahabe.
Í̠ tombeha gali bere birulebere. Í̠ igiri gali ogoni taba honowa ibu mini Yasu wibe, lalu lamini.

Ani lamialu lalu, Igiri ogoni ibu agali mini lene holebira. Wali agali bibahendeme lalu, Ibu Ngode Datagaliwabe Daligaorene Daliga Kagonaga Igini kagoni, lolebira. Anduane Homogo Ngode Datagaliwabehanda Yasu ibunaga mamali Debidi kini henedagua ibubi ho aribia ho helolebira.
Ibugua Yagaba aguanene karunaga kini haabobo bu holebira. Ibunaga handame ho holene wiaabobo bu wulebira, lalu lamini.
Ogonidagua lamiyagola Merihanda dahuliyali biagohondo lalu, I̱ wandari mabuage agalila nahene bedagodago bi áyu lariruni agua bialu bulubadabe, lene.

Ani layagola dahuliyali biagome ladai bialu lalu, Ngode Datagaliwabe Dinini í̠ha daluwa Ngode Datagaliwabenaga hongome í̠ karula holebira. Ani bulebirago manda buwa igiri taraore ogoni ibu Ngode Datagaliwabe Igini ka lalu lolebira, lene.

Dahuliyali biagome ani lamialu lalu, Í̠naga damene Ilisabede bedago mitangi bibe. Tigua ibu waneigini hono wibe nahe lenego áyu ibu wali waheore biruwa ibunaga tombeha gali bere beda. Gali biru bereane ege waragaria pene.
Ngode Datagaliwabehanda mbirale mbira nabibehe nawi, lalu lamini.
Ani lamiyagola Merihanda lalu, I̱ Anduane Homogonaga biabe bia hagane wandari bedogo í̠na áyu langiridagua i̱hondo biai helo, lene. Ani laya handala dahuliyali biagome Meri berea handala pene.
Meri ibu Ilisabede nenege penego ogo
Dahuliyali biago ibu piya handala Meri ibu heyalu abale pialu Yudiani bare wiaru iri dali bigi bima pialu tano mbira wiagoria anda pene.
Tano ogoriani anda pialu Segaraianaga andaga Ilisabede bereria puwa Merihanda ibuhondo, Hagibuni-o í̠ bederia nenege ibirugo, lene.
Merihanda Ilisabedehondo bi layago hale howa Ilisabedenaga tombeha gali birayagome ema bini. Ani bereria Ngode Datagaliwabe Dinini Ilisabede ibuha ho to̱layagola
Ilisabedehanda bi dalimu lalu, Meri-o í̠ wali maru bedarubi ndo Ngode Datagaliwabehanda í̠ore mo turu timbuniore hayada. Í̠na gali taba honoleberego ibubi mo turu holebira, lene.
Ani lowa lalu, I̱na bayale agi birugonaga i̱naga Anduane Homogo kagonaga ai̱ya í̠ i̱ berewaria ibiribe.
Í̠na lalu, Í̠ bederia nenege ibiru, larigo hale harugola i̱naga tombeha gali bedago ibu turu howa ema biya, lene.
Ilisabedehanda ogonidagua lamialu lalu, Anduane Homogohanda, Bulebero, layadagua henemane lola holebiragoni í̠na mini mbiraore wu bedegome í̠ turu timbuni ho birulebere, lalu lamini.
Merihanda turu ho biruwa iba gana lenego ogo
Lamiyagola Merihanda lalu,

content.text: I̱naga gubalinime Anduane Homogonaga mini yaraga harogoni.
Ngode Datagaliwabe ibu i̱naga Pele Ngiaga kago i̱naga miniha turu ho bedogo.
Ibunaga biabe bia haga wandari i̱ habane nabulene berewaria Ngode Datagaliwabe ibugua i̱ dara howa mitangi bini.
Ngode Datagaliwabe Hongo Gibihe kago ibugua galone dunini timbuni ogoni i̱hondo biyago mitangi bialu
áyu wali agali marumebi mani holebirarumebi, Meri ibu turu timbuni ho birulene nga, lolebira.
Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mini bayale honani ale ka.
Wali agali dabane áyu hama pedarubi mani ho aribia holebirarubi ti bibahendeme Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mini mo yaraga halu karu
Ngode Datagaliwabehanda tihondo dara howa biamogo bialu ka.
Wali agalime mine howa tini hangume bule lowa manda manda bu wu hearia
ibugua ibunaga gi hongo timbunihegome dogola a̱i̱ na̱i̱ biyagola ti wahalu kilikala lalu purogo lai hene.
Kini hongohe hearu handame ho hearia ibugua ti mo dindiha helalu
wali agali dindiha hearu mo yaraga ho helene.
Wali agalime tinaga miniha garibilo hearu bayale mbirale mbirale ibugua ti mo to̱la hai halu
wali agali mbirale mbirale dewawi hearu ibugua tini giha mbira nayi, Pudaba, lene.
Ibugua inanaga mamalihondo, Bulebero, lowinidagua buwa
ibunaga biabe bia haga Isaraele biamogo bule ibini.
Ibugua Abarahamabi Abarahamanaga aguanene ala henerubi mani holebirarubi tihondo dara howa biamogo bulene mitangi bia ho wiaabo ka,

content: lalu Merihanda bi ogonidagua lamaro bini.
Meri ibu Ilisabedela ege tebira agima biralu nde ibuni andaga dai bini.
Ilisabedehanda baboraya biaga Yone taba henenego ogo
Ilisabedehanda gali taba honolene tu hayagola ibugua igiri gali mbira taba henene.

Taba hanayagola wali agali mandagi haga hearubi ibunaga damene hearubi ti ibu berearia ibuwa tigua Anduane Homogohanda Ilisabedehondo bayale gibiore biyagola hale howa ti ibu heba mandagi turu haga bu hene.
Horo halini bolangua hayagola tigua igiri gali biagonaga dongone podo mabu bia hole pene. Puwa tigua igiri biago aba mini Segaraia winigo igiri biagonaga minibi Segaraia dege wule biyaria
ibu ai̱yahanda lalu, Ogoni ndo ibu mini Yone wimi̱ya, lene.
Ani layagola tigua ibuhondo lalu, Í̠naga damene bibahende karu mbirali mini ogoni lalehe mbira nahe, lene.
Ani lowa tigua ibu abahondo, Í̠ igini mini ai wule hamelo kebe, lalu gime walia hene.

Ani biyagola Segaraiahanda beba gili buliya ngi la nabi gime dege walia hene. Ani walia hayagola tigua ibuhondo beba mini. Miyagola ibugua bebani gili bialu, Ibu mini Yone, gili bini. Ani gili biyago de hondowa tigua handaya hene.
Ani gili biyaore Segaraia ibu bi lone labehe hearia ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabe mini yaraga halu hene.
Ani biyagola wali agali ti ibu heba mandagi haga hearume mogo timbuni lene. Yudia dindini bare bibahende wiaruniha tara ogoni biyiyagonaga te loyogo lalu hene.
Bibahendeme te ogoni layago hale hayaru tigua mitangi bialu, Anduane Homogonaga hongo holene ibu heba haore biaruago igiri ogoni ibugua agi bulenaga holobadabe, lalu hene.
Segaraiahanda mbiwia halu bi latagi henego ogo
Yone aba Segaraia ibuha Ngode Datagaliwabe Dinini ho to̱laihe howa ibugua mbiwia halu bi ogodagua latagi halu lalu,

content.text: Iname Anduane Homogo Isaraele wali agalinaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kagonaga mini yaraga hama.
Ibugua ibunaga wali agali biamogo bulene wiagoria ibalu ti golope hole hayada.
Ibunaga biabe bia haga Debidinaga aguanene mbirali
ogoni ibu inanaga Pele Ngiaga hongohe helo ibugua dabo helayada.
Ibugua ibunaga mana latagi haga lomo bia ho heleneruha howa bambaore ani bulebero lalu lowinigo ogo.
Inanaga waitigi karume ina dariba nahelobi
inahondo handabe manga ho karunaga hongo kagoha kamaria howabi ibugua, I̱na pele ngulebero, lalu lowini.
Ibugua inanaga mamalihondo dara howa, Biamogo bulebero, lalu,
Habo nalolene bi baya taraore mbira ala lowinigo mitangi bulebero, lalu lowini.
Ibugua inanaga mamali Abarahamahondo bi galone duniniore lowinigo ogo,
Iname gi nahe horo bibahende howa ibunaga biabe bia halu holoma̱ya
inanaga waitigi karume ina dariba ho ngagoria howa ibugua ina pele ngialu haru dai bulebero, lalu lowini.
Ani lenego irane ina dindini kamagola howa
ibu deni iname bayalebi tigabibi howa ibunaga biabe bialu holoma̱yanaga lowini.
I̱ igini-o tigua nde, Í̠ Ngode Datagaliwabe Daligaorene Daliga Kagonaga mana latagi haga kegoni, lolebira.
Anduane Homogo ibilo í̠na bamba halu ibunaga hariga ba halu mo tiga bima polebere.
Í̠na ibunaga wali agali lamialu, Tígua ko birimigo ibugua domo wahai halu pele ngulebira, lamulebere.
Inanaga Ngode Datagaliwabe ibu hendore howa dara halu biamogo biaga ka.
Ibugua ina haabo holoma̱ya pele mulene wá timbuniore holene aleme tagira ibalu
wali agali homolenenaga aruma holene ngagoria karu ibugua hari daligaha howa wá hadali helolebira.
Ina mo palia holene ngagoria pole pialu holoma̱yanaga ibugua bayuwaore haru holebira,

content: lalu bi ogoni Segaraiahanda mbiwia halu latagi hene.

Ibu igini biago mini tinginibi boga bialu hongo halu anda hene. Ani buwa ibugua Isaraele wali agali hearume ibu de hendelo hamani ha pani holene tu wilo lowa ibu dindi ko wali agali nahaga wiagoha haabo hene.
